observation.visible_scene: A tight close-up of a dark non-stick frying pan. In the center sits a small rectangular pat of pale butter, surrounded by a shallow pool of melted, golden butter that is actively bubbling. Fine oil droplets are scattered across the pan surface, and a soft highlight runs along the blurred upper rim of the pan.
visible_changes: The pool of melted butter around the solid pat gradually widens and spreads outward across the clip, growing from a compact ring to a broader, more irregular halo.
The solid pat stays near the center and remains largely intact, with its corners/edges softening and rounding slightly rather than moving or vanishing.
Bubbles continuously form and pop within the melted pool, most densely along the pat's perimeter, creating a foamy, flickering ring.
The scattered oil droplets on the pan hold their positions, indicating no lateral translation of the scene; the only clear change is the expansion of the melt pool and the bubbling.
outside_clip_unknowns: The heat source and pan temperature are not visible.
Whether the butter fully melts, browns, or is later joined by other ingredients is not shown.
The moments before the first frame and after the last frame are unknown.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is uncertain; the static background droplets suggest a fixed shot, but minor drift cannot be excluded.
The apparent slight reduction/rounding of the solid pat may be partly due to lighting and edge softening rather than a measured size change.
The exact origin of the bubbles (water/steam release vs. melting fat) cannot be confirmed from the images.
